rationale: The agent verified the user by email, correctly retrieved the gift card balance, checked the order details to identify the payment method (Mastercard ending 4336), and obtained explicit confirmation before changing the payment method on a pending order. The tool result shows the payment change and a corresponding refund entry, so the core actions were correct and policy-compliant. However, the agent stated a specific refund timeframe (“within 5 to 7 business days”) that is not supported by any tool output. Providing an unsupported, fabricated timeframe violates the policy requirement not to invent missing facts and to give correct final information. There was also a broad assertion that payment methods cannot be combined, which is not validated by the tools, though it did not lead to a prohibited action. Due to the fabricated refund timeframe, this interaction does not meet the pass bar.
